instruction: Review before running verify_stage_a. Each entry is either (a) an LLM-uncertain merge decision, or (b) a CODE_DEFINITE_DUPLICATE that enriched a BEHAVIORAL statement with inferred fields from an IMPLICIT_TRANSITION. Verify that from_state, to_state, pre_cond, post_cond, and trigger are correct for each kept statement.

entries.warning: REVIEW: enriched N-S070-004 with fields ['to_state', 'post_cond'] from D-S070-006 — verify correctness
entries.s1_description: The client MUST echo the same Init Cookie options, in the same order, in each succeeding DCCP packet until one of those packets is acknowledged (showing that the three-way handshake has completed) or the connection is reset.
entries.s2_description: If so, then the client MUST echo the same Init Cookie options, in the same order, in each succeeding DCCP packet until one of those packets is acknowledged (showing that the three-way handshake has completed) or the connection is reset.

entries.s1_description: Servers MUST reject any DCCP-Request with Service Code value 4294967295 by sending a DCCP-Reset packet with Reset Code 8, "Bad Service Code".
entries.s2_description: Servers MUST reject any DCCP-Request with this Service Code value by sending a DCCP-Reset packet with Reset Code 8, "Bad Service Code".

entries.llm_reason: Both statements describe the same normative requirement for a CHANGING endpoint to reset with Reset Code 5 upon receiving an empty Confirm for a required feature.
entries.s1_description: The CHANGING endpoint SHOULD reset the connection (with Reset Code 5, 'Option Error') if it receives an empty Confirm option for such a feature [required to be understood by all DCCPs].
entries.s2_description: The CHANGING endpoint SHOULD reset the connection (with Reset Code 5, "Option Error") if it receives an empty Confirm option for such a feature.

entries.llm_reason: Both statements describe the same SHOULD obligation to send Data Dropped options when peer sends data inappropriately in an ECN-incapable context.
entries.s1_description: it MUST NOT accept any data until the other endpoint sends 'Confirm R(ECN Incapable, 1)'. It SHOULD send Data Dropped options on its acknowledgements, with Drop Code 0 ('protocol constraints'), if the other endpoint does send data inappropriately.
entries.s2_description: It SHOULD send Data Dropped options on its acknowledgements, with Drop Code 0 ("protocol constraints"), if the other endpoint does send data inappropriately.
